create.name: Colleen Benelli
create.bio:
Colleen Benelli is a Reiki master teacher and shamanic practitioner based in the Portland area of Oregon. She came to Reiki through her horse, Dakota, after a bad injury sent her looking for ways to help him, and she went on to train in Reiki with William Lee Rand, founder of the ICRT (International Center for Reiki Training), and in shamanic studies with Jan Engels-Smith at the LightSong School, where she earned a shamanic doctorate. She is a licensed Reiki master teacher, co-directs the ICRT's licensed teacher programme, leads its programme development, and co-wrote the ICRT's Animal Reiki courses and manuals.

In 2004 she founded Reiki Lifestyle, which she now runs with her daughter, Robyn Benelli. Together they teach Usui and Holy Fire Reiki, Karuna Reiki and Animal Reiki, mostly live on Zoom, with some in-person classes in Oregon and at Omega in Rhinebeck, New York. They also created Next Step Reiki, a three-year programme of guided Reiki journeys and channelling, and Explore the 12 Heavens, a year-long course on spirit guides and higher realms. Her teaching is gentle and practical, mixing guided journeys with time to practise. She co-hosts the Reiki Lifestyle podcast and has written for Reiki News Magazine since 2005.

courses.title: Reiki Heals People & Animals: A Sacred Exchange
courses.description: A two-hour live online class through Omega on Animal Reiki as a two-way exchange between people, animals and the Earth. It includes guided Reiki meditations, a spiritual journey and a live question-and-answer session, with the recording available for six months.
courses.price: Member $35 USD, standard $44 USD (sliding scale $33–$55 USD)

courses.title: Usui / Holy Fire III Reiki 1 & 2
courses.description: A two-day live Zoom class for beginners that gives the first two levels of Usui and Holy Fire III Reiki. Students learn to give sessions to themselves, others in person and at a distance, with plenty of practice time.

courses.title: Usui / Holy Fire III World Peace Reiki Master
courses.description: A three-day live Zoom master class for students who have held level 2 for at least six months. It prepares students to teach and attune others in the Usui and Holy Fire III system.

courses.title: Holy Fire III Karuna Reiki Master Class
courses.description: A three-day live online workshop for Reiki masters in Holy Fire III World Peace Karuna Reiki, a system centred on compassion. Graduates are qualified to teach and attune others in Karuna Reiki.

courses.title: ICRT Animal Reiki 1 & 2 Training
courses.description: A two-day course, live on Zoom or at in-person destination classes, in the ICRT's Animal Reiki method, which Benelli co-wrote. Students learn to offer Reiki to animals and nature with attention to safety and consent.

courses.title: ICRT Animal Reiki Master Training
courses.description: A three-day advanced Animal Reiki course for those who want to deepen the practice and teach it. It is held live on Zoom, with occasional in-person cohorts.

courses.title: Next Step Reiki Level 1: Reiki Journey Techniques
courses.description: The first year of the Next Step Reiki programme, with monthly live Zoom classes and quarterly mentoring calls. It teaches guided Reiki journeys and new tools for students who already hold Reiki 1 and 2 from any lineage.
courses.price: $188 USD a month, or $2,145 USD in full

courses.title: Next Step Reiki Level 2: Advanced Healing Techniques
courses.description: The second year of Next Step Reiki, taught live online once a month with quarterly question-and-answer sessions. It builds on the journey work of level 1 with more advanced session techniques.
courses.price: $188 USD a month, or $2,145 USD in full

courses.title: Next Step Reiki Level 3: Channeling Techniques
courses.description: The third year of Next Step Reiki, focused on channelling and receiving guidance during Reiki practice. Classes are monthly on Zoom, with recordings for anyone who misses a session.
courses.price: $175 USD a month, or $1,995 USD in full

courses.title: Explore the 12 Heavens
courses.description: A year-long live online course in which Colleen and Robyn Benelli lead guided Reiki journeys through twelve higher realms to meet spirit guides. Open to anyone with Reiki 1 and 2 from any lineage.
courses.price: $188 USD a month, or $2,145 USD in full

free_resources.title: Prayers & Invocations
free_resources.description: A free PDF by Colleen and Robyn Benelli with prayers and invocations for opening Reiki sessions, plus guidance on writing your own. Available in English and Spanish.

free_resources.title: Self-Reiki Hand Positions Poster
free_resources.description: A free printable poster showing the hand positions for a self-Reiki session. Handy as a reminder for a daily practice.
